answer: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is an advanced AI framework that combines information retrieval with text generation models, allowing large language models to reference authoritative knowledge bases outside their training data sources before generating a response [1], [2], [3], [4]. It connects the model with external knowledge bases, enabling it to produce more accurate and up-to-date responses [2] and ground its output in relevant information [4]. RAG is also described as a technique that enables large language models to retrieve and incorporate new information [5].
